Cement Quirk.name: Cement Quirk
Cement Quirk.description:
🧱 You turn existing cement and concrete into new shapes through touch.

🌱 At the start you reshape concrete connected to your touch within five meters into a chest-high wall two meters across, a low ridge or several steps.
📈 With training: restraints, supported rescue passages, tall platforms, large connected walls.
⚠️ You need touch and connected cement or concrete; you add no mass, cannot shape other materials or reinforcement, and poor support can collapse or rupture utilities.
🔗 Canon Drawback, built in: Stamina Drain, as repeated large reshaping exhausts your body.
🎬 Canon Quirk: Ken Ishiyama / Cementoss's Cement. You are not related to him; people who know his Quirk notice the resemblance.

📈 Grants: Technique +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Output +10, Search and Rescue +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Pavement Cover Rise, Concrete Heel Bump
Cement Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects:
Scale: touch reshapes linked cement or concrete within 5 m; it flows, sets, adds no mass. Start: 2 m chest-high wall, low ridge or steps. Tall platforms, big partitions, braced rescue passages need training.
Limits: needs an unbroken concrete link; rock, soil, brick, asphalt, metal, wood, flesh never respond; rebar won't bend. Thin paving gives little; walls break; careless work undermines buildings or bursts utilities. No remote sight, buried-person sense or untouched-slab control.
Quirk Strain: light: cover, low bump; moderate: ankle restraints, stairs; heavy: shelter bracing, moving partitions, tall platforms; severe: broad surge, long construction.
Drawback: built in, the canon Stamina Drain.
Canon: Ken Ishiyama / Cementoss's Quirk; user is unrelated, no tie unless the story makes one; those who know it see the resemblance.
Type: Emitter.
Law: public reshaping needs an emergency or licensed duty; unauthorized trapping is unlawful confinement.
Look: angular face.
